import java.util.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlow {
    static final boolean DEBUG_ON = false;
    static final long INF_FLOW = (long) 1e14;
    static final long INF_COST = (long) 1e14;
    static final int MAXN = 50 * 100 + 15;
    static final int SRC_IDX = MAXN - 1;
    static final int SINK_IDX = MAXN - 2;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        long cost;

        public Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }

        long remaining() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static int total_nodes = MAXN;
    static List<Integer>[] adj_list = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> edge_list = new ArrayList<>();

    static long[] dist_arr = new long[MAXN];
    static long total_cost_value;
    static int[] prev_edge_idx = new int[MAXN];
    static long[] capacity_arr = new long[MAXN];
    static long max_flow_value;
    static boolean[] in_q = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void insert_edge(int u, int v, long cap, long cst) {
        if (DEBUG_ON) {
            String u_str = Integer.toString(u);
            String v_str = Integer.toString(v);
            if (u == SRC_IDX) u_str = "SRC";
            if (u == SINK_IDX) u_str = "SINK";
            if (v == SRC_IDX) v_str = "SRC";
            if (v == SINK_IDX) v_str = "SINK";
            System.out.println("add edge: " + u_str + " " + v_str + " " + cap + " " + cst);
        }
        adj_list[u].add(edge_list.size());
        edge_list.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cst));
        adj_list[v].add(edge_list.size());
        edge_list.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cst));
    }

    static void min_cost_max_flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(in_q, false);
        max_flow_value = 0;
        total_cost_value = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_arr, INF_COST);
            dist_arr[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(prev_edge_idx, -1);
            prev_edge_idx[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(capacity_arr, 0);
            capacity_arr[s] = INF_FLOW;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            in_q[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                in_q[u] = false;
                for (int i : adj_list[u]) {
                    Edge E = edge_list.get(i);
                    if (E.remaining() > 1e-9 && dist_arr[E.v] > dist_arr[u] + E.cost + 1e-9) {
                        dist_arr[E.v] = dist_arr[u] + E.cost;
                        prev_edge_idx[E.v] = i;
                        capacity_arr[E.v] = Math.min(capacity_arr[u], E.remaining());
                        if (!in_q[E.v]) {
                            q.offer(E.v);
                            in_q[E.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (prev_edge_idx[t] < 0) break;
            long flow = capacity_arr[t];
            max_flow_value += flow;
            total_cost_value += flow * dist_arr[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = edge_list.get(prev_edge_idx[v]).u) {
                Edge e = edge_list.get(prev_edge_idx[v]);
                e.flow += flow;
                edge_list.get(prev_edge_idx[v] ^ 1).flow -= flow;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            adj_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        long c = sc.nextLong();
        long d = sc.nextLong();

        long MAXT = n + k;
        if (DEBUG_ON) System.out.println("MAXT: " + MAXT);
        int[] a = new int[(int) k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            insert_edge(SRC_IDX, a[i] * (int) MAXT, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT; j++) {
            insert_edge(j, SINK_IDX, k, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    insert_edge(x * (int) MAXT + j, y * (int) MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    insert_edge(y * (int) MAXT + j, x * (int) MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    insert_edge(i * (int) MAXT + j, i * (int) MAXT + j + 1, 1, c);
                }
            }
        }
        min_cost_max_flow(SRC_IDX, SINK_IDX);
        if (DEBUG_ON) System.out.println("mincost: " + total_cost_value + " maxflow: " + max_flow_value);
        System.out.println(total_cost_value);
        sc.close();
    }
}
